tagline: Fuel your mornings, fuel your ambitions.
description: NovaBrew is a premium D2C coffee brand that blends science-backed brewing with bold, expressive branding. We target young urban professionals who treat their morning ritual as a form of self-care.
target_audience: Urban millennials and Gen Z, 22-38, career-driven, aesthetic-conscious, wellness-oriented.
brand_voice: Bold, witty, aspirational but grounded. Never corporate. Uses casual language, occasional humor, and motivational undertones.
image_style: Dark moody photography with warm amber tones. Close-up textures of coffee beans, steam rising from cups, hands wrapped around mugs. Editorial + cozy aesthetic.

posting_tone_by_platform.LinkedIn: Professional storytelling, insightful, warm and human
